summary: Bump curated model IDs to current frontier releases (Grok/DeepSeek/Gemini) + scrub stale model-name refs
description:
PR to guru-web: refresh curated model picker to current frontier releases and remove stale hardcoded model names.

## Model bumps (3, user-requested)
Edit `src/lib/curated-models.ts` (CURATED_MODELS, ~lines 22-26) AND mirror each new ID in `src/lib/fallback-pricing.ts` (CI guard `src/__tests__/curated-models-coverage.test.ts` fails if a curated ID has no fallback row).

1. Grok: `x-ai/grok-4.3` -> `x-ai/grok-4.6`  (was 2 gens behind; 4.6 = current flagship, 500K ctx, $2/$6 on OpenRouter)
2. DeepSeek: `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro` -> `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813`  (bare slug pins the April 0423 snapshot; 0813 = Aug 13 newer weights, same V4-Pro family). NOTE: deepseek is DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG — serves all free users, so this snapshot matters most.
3. Gemini: `google/gemini-3.6-flash` -> `google/gemini-3.7-flash`  (GA Aug 13 2026. 3.8 Flash is on OpenRouter but not GA per Google release notes — 3.7 is the stable target.)

OUT OF SCOPE (already current-gen, leave alone): OpenAI `openai/gpt-5.6-terra`, Anthropic `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`.

## REQUIRED: pricing re-sync (must be in PR description)
Model IDs are the version-rollover mechanism; new IDs have no pricing row until synced. After editing:
    npm run sync-pricing        # = npx tsx scripts/sync-pricing.ts; pulls OpenRouter model_pricing, adds rows for new IDs
Document this in the PR body so whoever merges knows pricing must be re-synced on land. (Workflow documented in curated-models.ts:11-13.)

## Cleanup: scrub stale hardcoded model-name references
Principle (owner): avoid naming specific model versions in copy/comments — they go stale. Prefer version-free provider naming.
Strongest fixes:
- `src/lib/provider-display.ts:106` — comment example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6`
- `src/lib/model.ts:74` — comment prose "Claude Sonnet 4.5"
- `src/lib/pricing-config.ts:69` — comment asserts curated set = "deepseek-v4-pro, grok-4.3, sonnet-4.6, gpt-5.4" (stale/wrong now)
Lower priority / handle deliberately:
- `src/lib/pricing-config.ts:66,71` — sonnet-4.5 historical calibration data; may be legit-historical, judge in place.
- `src/lib/fallback-pricing.ts:64,69` — INTENTIONAL one-release safety net (`anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6`, `openai/gpt-5.4`), documented "drop on next bump". Don't treat as accidental; update deliberately as part of the rollover.
- Internal docs: `docs/model-selection/BRD-*.md`, `docs/model-selection/IMPL-*.md`, `docs/guru-web-build-plan.md` — stale IDs presented as current; optional doc hygiene.

## Done contract
- curated-models.ts + fallback-pricing.ts updated for all 3 IDs
- `npm run sync-pricing` run; pricing rows exist for new IDs
- coverage test + suite green
- stale refs (at least the 3 strongest) scrubbed
- PR body documents the sync-pricing step
- guru-web main is PROTECTED — branch + gh pr create, never push main

resolution.note: Bumped grok-4.3→4.6, gemini-3.6→3.8, deepseek-v4-pro→0813; all verified in OpenRouter catalog; sync-pricing seeded rows; fallback safety-net rolled; stale model-name comments scrubbed; questionsPerDay guardrails recalibrated to real prices. Needs sync-pricing on deploy.
